who: Robert M. Calhoon, historian of early America at the University of North Carolina at Greensboro.

LC identifies Robert M. (Robert McCluer) Calhoon as a history professor at UNCG and author of Political Moderation in America's First Two Centuries.

notes: The named dissertation director and candidate authority agree in full name and institution. The supplied doctorate was not independently checked.

who: James Taylor Carson, historian of Indigenous North America at Queen's University, PhD Kentucky 1996.

evidence.says: Queen's lists James Carson as professor, with a University of Kentucky PhD in 1996 and graduate supervision fields including First Nations history and colonial encounters.

LC identifies James Taylor Carson as the author of Searching for the Bright Path; its citation for The Columbian Covenant identifies the author as James Carson, history chair at Queen's University.

notes: The authority explicitly bridges James Carson and James Taylor Carson; university, doctorate year and publications agree.
